bio: Located in the Dreimühlenviertel, this charming old brick building was a fish market back when it was set amid an abattoir and wholesale butchers. Now it has evolved into this attractive restaurant, which has been designed with an individual touch. Although seafood dominates the menu, it is far from being the only option. Those who prefer meat can indulge in a fillet of beef, to name but one example. Highly recommended for groups: a whole fish to share, eg. turbot, char or Atlantic lobster. Be sure to leave room for dessert – the chocolate cake is a tempting proposition! To accompany your meal, there is an extensive selection of fine wines to choose from....
